images.after: Text size, line length and line height
images.title: Which numbers come from a standard
images.alt: Table separating what WCAG sets for text size, line length, line height and tap targets from common design convention.
images.caption: Some values are published rules and some are habit. Knowing which is which tells you where you have room to adjust.

images.title: Reserve the space before it loads
images.alt: Four cards: the cause of layout shift, fixes for images and ad slots, and Google's Cumulative Layout Shift target of 0.1 or less.
images.caption: Text jumps when something loads late and pushes it down. Holding the gap in advance stops it.

items.title: The cause
items.text: An image or ad loads late and pushes the text you're reading down the page

items.title: Images
items.text: Give every image width and height attributes, or a CSS aspect-ratio

items.title: Ad slots
items.text: Set a minimum height on the container so the slot is there before the ad

items.title: How it's measured
items.text: Google calls it Cumulative Layout Shift; 0.1 or less counts as good

images.title: Pop-ups and ads: keep or remove
images.alt: Comparison of acceptable sign-up and ad formats, like in-article forms and slim banners, against full-screen overlays and heavy ad density.
images.caption: Google's guidance and the Coalition for Better Ads point the same way: the article comes first.

columns.label: Fine to keep
points: Slim banner using a small part of the screen
Legally required gates, such as age checks
Ads well under 30% of mobile article height

columns.label: Remove
points: Redirect to a separate sign-up page
More ads than content on a screen
Large sticky ads or autoplay video with sound
